<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 4:42">Targ. II Kings IV, 42</cite> <he>בלְבוּשֵׁיה</he> (ed. Lag. <he>בלבשיה</he>); h. text <he>בצקלנו</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 63a:1">Keth. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>שאילי מאני לבוש וכ׳</he> borrow dressy garments and cover thyself (to meet thy husband).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 21:5">Gen. R. s. 21</cite> <he>דלְבוּשֵׁיה מיניה וביה</he> whose covering is a part of (inseparable from) its body.
<cite ref="Shabbat 77b:11">Sabb. 77ᵇ</cite> (playful etymology) <he>לבושא לא בושה</he> no shame.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 4:1">Targ. Esth. IV, 1</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Tamid 32a:68">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>לבישין דארגון</he> purple garments; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Zechariah 12:6">Targ. Zech. XII, 6</cite> <he>ל׳ דנור</he> (h. text <he>כיור אש</he>).
